rounds.text: Maitri Enterprises Ltd trades at an attractive P/E of 22x against a sector benchmark of 35.78x and a price-to-book ratio of 3.26x compared to the sector benchmark of 3.77x [E1, E6, E7]. The business demonstrates robust historical top-line expansion, boasting a 10-year compounded sales growth rate of 59% alongside solid 5-year and 3-year compounded sales growth of 48% [E14, E15, E16]. Profitability metrics are further reinforced by a strong Return on Capital Employed of 16.17% beating the sector median of 9.9%, alongside impressive operational cash generation that saw operating cash flow reach 124% of operating profit in March 2026 [E10, E35, E73]. Fundamental momentum remains exceptional, highlighted by a rules-based screen score of 90 out of 100 driven by a staggering year-over-year net profit surge of 7200% and sales growth of 131% [E62, E63, E65]. The company is actively deleveraging, with total borrowings dropping significantly from Rs 6.30 Cr to Rs 4.30 Cr over the past year, while debtor days dramatically improved from 54.1 to 28.2 days [E37, E57]. Conceded: the dividend yield is 0.00%, the 10-year median return on equity stands at a modest 8%, and the stock carries an annualized volatility of 145.9% [E4, E24, E50].
